paper: A binary [78,36,12] code from the passant lines of a conic over F13

claims.statement: The binary passant incidence code has length 78 and dimension 36.

claims.lean_target: structural reductions plus kernel-checked finite certificates

claims.statement: There are 364 minimum words in four PGL(2,13)-orbits of size 91.
Each minimum-word orbit spans the 36-dimensional code.
The minimum supports reconstruct the elliptic scheme and the 78 passant incidence rows.
claims.lean_target: formal reconstruction interface with kernel-checked finite profiles

claims.statement: The coordinate-permutation automorphism group of the minimum-support system is PGL(2,13).
claims.lean_target: formal anchor theorem plus kernel-checked finite uniqueness
